purpose: Measure the amplification operator of the actual coupled D3Q27 stream-collide and straight characteristic boundary; do not keep adding time-order variants after failed AB3 noise tests.
state: For one integer transverse Fourier mode, Nx*27 owned PDF amplitudes plus the coherent outlet incoming-invariant and derivative histories. Periodic y,z, nonperiodic x, constant reservoir inflow. Boundary link histories are indexed by their normal foot, not their originating fluid point.
operator: Central plus/minus perturbations of every state basis, followed by exactly one actual time_step; complex Fourier projection of the difference. All PDF buffers and boundary histories reset from a uniform equilibrium before each evaluation.

checks.growth_classification: A radius greater than 1+1e-6 is unstable in this linearized finite-domain block. A radius below that threshold is only this mode's result, not a general stability proof or airfoil acceptance.

outputs: leading mode magnitude versus x CSV
operator matrix SHA256, without exporting its binary
unchanged: collision, bulk rate, viscosity, Reynolds reference, lattice speed
previous physical and noise acceptance gates
scope: Linear code verification around uniform equilibrium, not experimental validation. Run the epsilon check first on the leading unstable mode before extending work.
